title: Pro$^2$ Agent: Scientific Problem Probing for Autonomous AI R&D
abstract: arXiv:2611.25357v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now autonomously conduct AI research by writing code and running experiments. They typically do so by iteratively optimizing a codebase, while ignoring the problem structure behind the task. This formulation is effective on simpler tasks, but on difficult problems it often gets stuck in the wrong solution region because the agent never explicitly represents its understanding of the problem. We introduce Pro$^2$ Agent, which shifts the primary state of autonomous AI research from a codebase state to a Problem State: an explicit structure of what problems prevent success and which solutions are likely to address them. Pro$^2$ Agent initializes the Problem State through comprehensive analysis of available resources and constraints. translated_title: Pro$^2$ Agent：面向自主AI研发的科学问题探测方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体现在能够通过编写代码和运行实验来自主开展AI研究。它们通常采用迭代优化代码库的方式进行，却忽视了任务背后的问题结构。这种模式在较简单的任务上是有效的，但在困难问题上，智能体由于从未显式地表达其对问题的理解，往往会陷入错误的解区域。我们提出了Pro$^2$ Agent，它将自主AI研究的主要状态从代码库状态转变为问题状态：这是一种显式的结构，用于刻画哪些问题阻碍了成功，以及哪些解决方案有可能解决这些问题。Pro$^2$ Agent通过对可用资源和约束条件的全面分析来初始化问题状态，随后进行有针对性的研究，将识别出的问题与候选解决方案关联起来。通过受控的假设检验，智能体会更新可疑（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: Pro$^2$ Agent将自主AI研究的核心状态从代码库转变为显式的问题状态，通过全面分析、定向研究和受控假设检验来识别阻碍成功的问题并匹配候选解决方案，从而避免智能体在困难问题上陷入错误的解区域。
en_tdlr: Pro$^2$ Agent shifts the primary state of autonomous AI research from a codebase to an explicit Problem State, identifying blocking problems and matching them with candidate solutions through comprehensive analysis, targeted research, and controlled hypothesis testing.
